d:
In a world where magic and darkness intertwine, a noble armored warrior and an elven mage stand as the last line of defense against a rising demonic force. What begins as a desperate battle against corrupted creatures soon spirals into something far more dangerous. As the warrior falls in combat, the elf, driven by fear and devotion, defies ancient laws and casts a forbidden spell to save him.

But the magic comes at a cost.

The warrior awakens… changed.

A strange power begins to grow within him—shadows answer his will, his armor reshapes into something alive, and whispers from unseen entities guide his actions. As his transformation deepens, the battlefield itself begins to warp under his presence, spreading an eerie purple aura that corrupts everything it touches.

Watching from afar, a demonic archer—once confident and untouchable—realizes too late that something far more terrifying has been unleashed.

Now, caught between salvation and damnation, the warrior must confront what he has become… while the elf faces the consequences of the power she chose to wield.

And in the shadows, something ancient is awakening.
